method: Personally inspected all19existing incomplete-scene prepared photos at original resolution via view_image, then read their retained r21OCR/query/export rows. Expected metadata was loaded after this pass's photo inspection; prior project knowledge means this is not an independently blinded study. No new OCR, crop, image, catalogue/model call or dataset mutation.
scope: Supplementary visible-label diagnosis only. No canonical reference, producer alias, sensory value or affinity is granted. Existing r21metrics and current source freeze remain unchanged.

rows.issue: Retained OCR supports both main name/capsule brand; first query Soleá stays broad while Valdebebas completes. Producer and exact selection qualifier require catalogue evidence.
rows.action: Combine only independently visible name/brand fields when supported by the catalogue query contract; do not infer legal producer.

rows.issue: Bagante literal query is complete but broad Bierzo still blocks the retained scene. Small digits under name are not safe harvest evidence.
rows.action: Prefer name-bearing evidence over generic region as a bounded search axis; do not reinterpret unreadable digits as a vintage.

rows.issue: Name and producer are legible; public literal name is complete and producer is broad. Later known export-IDdetail existence is not proof the image was matched.
rows.action: Validate existing includeUnlisted hosted contract before expecting the public partial store to resolve this case. Lot numbering is not a harvest.

rows.issue: Useful producer Vignamadre is in retained OCR, but the second retained query uses generic D'Abruzzo. Product image has a Vivino watermark unrelated to wine identity.
rows.action: Keep watermark excluded and use visible identity-bearing producer/name evidence, without silently equating brand spacing or legal producer.

rows.issue: Retained first queries illet/Selecsi come from poor capsule snippets despite useful larger front-label text. OCR also returns distorted Protos spellings. The age phrase alone does not establish a Crianza classification.
rows.action: Prioritize strong label-region text and retain selection/age qualifiers. No forced Protos correction from expected filename, no assumed Crianza or harvest1921.

rows.issue: 2018is plainly printed on the front and collar, but retained OCR/year extraction has no harvest. Producer Muga is not established by this front image.
rows.action: A future bounded local OCRregion pass may recover the year without paid AI; first keep existing evidence and require trusted catalogue source for producer. Do not inject manually read year into benchmark OCR.

rows.issue: Both generic producer and appellation queries are partial. Export Classico/Riserva qualifiers are not plainly present on the inspected front label.
rows.action: Need exact canonical variant/producer filtering, not a first-row match or sensory defaults.1857is not a harvest.

rows.issue: Strong cru/site qualifiers are readable, but retained second query remains appellation-wide.
rows.action: Preserve PremierCru/EnServy and producer separation; do not remove site qualifiers to obtain a generic match.

rows.issue: Retained OCR also finds Tradition/Blanc de Noirs in small text. Export producer Guillemot-Michel differs from the visible Guilleminot string; no verified alias is established.
rows.action: Flag producer metadata discrepancy for source review, not an invented alias. Preserve broad-query pending status until exact catalogue evidence.

rows.issue: Retained first query NGUT is a truncated capsule word, while larger GROSS/front-label variety are legible. Both retained queries are partial.
rows.action: Suppress weak capsule fragments in favor of independent main-label identity fields; no automatic canonical match.

rows.issue: Handheld real photo with condensation and award sticker. Retained OCR correctly keeps1995, not sticker2004, but queries Campillo/OUNA lose the clear ReservaEspecial qualifier.
rows.action: Keep correct year-role discrimination and visible selection qualifier; require canonical/year detail before affinity.

rows.issue: Clear name/producer but both independent queries remain broad.
rows.action: Use supported conjunction of name and producer, not a first appellation match. No hidden cru or harvest claim.

rows.issue: Retained OCR/year extraction already captures2022andsite. Generic Meursault query is partial; known later2024detail cannot answer the photographed2022sensory question.
rows.action: Preserve exact site/year and explicit vintage gap; no borrowing of2024sensory attributes.

rows.issue: Small140x520product image with stacked typography. Retained OCR only yields LA/TERA/MA DE DUERO, losing PIA and the visible2024. Producer Vináticos in export is not legible from this front label.
rows.action: Keep insufficient-text state; evaluate a bounded local-region OCR/visual-retrieval path later, never reconstruct name from export expectation.

rows.issue: Visible brand has several possible variants; sole retained query is broad.1870is brand history rather than harvest.
rows.action: Require exact selection/variant matching and do not use first brand result or founding year.

rows.issue: Name query completes while generic Montepulciano has a retained incomplete public route; no new server error is proven by this old receipt.
rows.action: Keep existing cached failure; verify hosted canonical route only under separate authorization. No guessed alternate URL or producer alias.

rows.issue: Small producer mark is less legible. Retained OCR reads PONT rather than POINT, and broad ZERO remains partial. Product name alone does not establish a measured alcohol percentage.
rows.action: Retain spelling uncertainty and require label-image/canonical evidence for recovery; no hardcoded Leitz or alcohol estimate from export/name.

rows.issue: Front image does not show an unambiguous grape. Retained OCR separates DA/LUCA and searches LUCA alone; export PinotGrigio cannot be verified from this photographed face.
rows.action: Keep whole visible brand in any supported query, then require back-label/catalogue variant evidence. Do not infer grape from bottle colour.

rows.issue: Retained OCRreadsALTOTINTO and2021correctly, while exported nameScattola is not plainly visible in this front image. Altotinto route is a retained incomplete public response, not proof of a fresh outage.
rows.action: Keep2021andselection, require exact brand/reference relationship from trusted catalogue, and preserve error without guessed slugs.
